title: Ford GT vs GT40: The Difference Nobody Explains
description:
The Ford G T forty won Le Mans four times in a row in the nineteen sixties. Fifty years later, the modern Ford GT went back to Le Mans and won too. They look related, they carry the same mission, and they wear the same name, almost. But they are completely different machines, and the biggest difference is not the engine. It is what each one was actually built to win. One was a pure race car that happened to have some road versions. The other was a road car built so that a race car could exist. One cost a few thousand pounds when new and now sells for millions. The other cost about half a million dollars and is now valued at more. Today we explain the real difference, step by step.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
